name: 02724 · Fall River, MA
findings: ZIP 02724 (Fall River) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02724 (Fall River) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
